description: This source file defines the feature for deleting an article in an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR. It includes a command, validation, and a handler that interacts with the database context to delete an article by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete article command by querying the article by slug and removing it from the database.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion of an article based on the provided slug, handling potential not found errors.
